title: Modified Clarke-Wright for OVRP
summary: Open-VRP adaptation of Clarke-Wright with formula modification and open-route construction.

attributes.not_the_original: CW merge of routes is not select_next_node. Abstract does not use savings as a next-customer score.
attributes.variant_adaptation_note: 开放式车辆路径问题（OVRP）不要求车辆返回仓库，因此端点合并公式与标准闭环 CVRP 不同（不再节省返程边 d(i,0) 或 d(j,0)）。迁移回标准闭环 CVRP 时必须恢复完整闭环节约量 s(i,j)=d(0,i)+d(0,j)-d(i,j) 并强制所有路径起止于仓库 0（见 method-lit-cvrp-construct-clarke-wright-savings-merge）。
